instruction: On my Ubuntu system, I'd like to configure Thunderbird as the default email client. Please help me set this up.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Thunderbird as default email client. Evaluator checks xdg-mime setting for x-scheme-handler/mailto to verify thunderbird.desktop is registered. Similar complexity to original VLC task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default email client using 'xdg-mime query default x-scheme-handler/mailto'
Metric 'check_include_exclude' appropriately checks if 'thunderbird.desktop' is in result
Expected value 'thunderbird.desktop' is semantically correct for Thunderbird on Linux
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single instruction requirement
Metric parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', framework calls get_rule which returns rules dict directly
Edge case handled: getter returns 'unknown' if no email client set, which correctly fails verification
